name: Polygonal Bokeh via Thin Lens Aperture
aliases: Polygonal Bokeh via Thin Lens Aperture — N-Blade Aperture Sampling
definition: A camera effect that renders polygonal bokeh (hexagonal/octagonal) using an N-blade polygonal aperture with rotation and area-uniform sampling.
summary: Polygonal Bokeh via Thin Lens Aperture renders out-of-focus highlights as distinct polygonal shapes by modeling the camera aperture as a regular N-sided polygon, differing from standard circular disk sampling.
